name: com.globalvisualizer.core
description: Virtualized list, grid, flow and scroller framework for uGUI. Bind any prefab to any data: only the visible items are created and their GameObjects are pooled. Variable item sizes, selection, keyboard and gamepad navigation, drag-or-scroll, empty placeholder and Hierarchy menus.

samples.description: Ready-made scene: interactive lessons, a playground for every setting, a benchmark against a normal ScrollRect + LayoutGroup, and an in-scene self test. Open GlobalVisualizerShowcase.unity and press Play.
A vertical list of 10,000 items, a horizontal list and a grid, built at runtime.
Multi-selection, keyboard and gamepad focus, double and right click, snapping, rows sized by a provider, a measured tag flow and the empty placeholder.
